audience: engineering teams that run applications and environments on Qovery

useCases.title: Check whether environments and services are running
useCases.text: List the environments of a project and read the status of one. Then read the status of a database, application or job.

useCases.title: Review recent deployments and their results
useCases.text: List the recent deployments of an environment, with what triggered them and their result. Then list its services to see what each one runs.

useCases.title: Check the health of a Kubernetes cluster
useCases.text: List the clusters of an organization and read the status of one. The status gives the reason for any problem.

useCases.title: Redeploy an application with its current commit
useCases.text: Redeploy one application with the same Git commit or image it runs now. Use it to rebuild or restart the app from its current source.

useCases.title: Stop an environment or restart an application
useCases.text: Stop all services of an environment, or restart the pods of one application without a new build. Stopped services stay offline until someone deploys them again.
